## Better questions need visible assumptions. {#manifesto-title}

::::::::::

:::::::::: {.manifesto-copy}

Scando-lab is led by Michele Scandola, Associate Professor of Neuropsychology and Cognitive
Neuroscience in the Department of Human Sciences at the University of Verona. Our work
crosses methodological and disciplinary borders without losing sight of the people
represented by the data.

We connect statistical reasoning with research on body representations, pain,
neuropsychological assessment, young people not in education, employment or training,
eco-emotions and neurodivergence. The common thread is simple: careful measurement, explicit
uncertainty and knowledge that others can inspect and build upon.

::::::::::
